title: IRTIQA: Evolving in English, Evaluated in Urdu -- Does Agent Self-Evolution Transfer from English to Urdu and Code-Switched Input?
abstract: arXiv:2611.34303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As LLM agents increasingly learn from their own experience, the tasks they learn from and are evaluated on are almost always in English. We ask whether self-evolution transfers from English to Urdu, and release IRTIQA, a benchmark of aligned English, Urdu-translated, and Urdu code-switched variants of DROP, SNIPS, AppWorld, and SkillsBench, built with a matrix-language code-switching pipeline and human verification. Using IRTIQA, we evaluate three self-evolving frameworks, Tool-R0 (self-play RL), AgentEvolver (experience-guided RL), and Autogenesis (protocol-level evolution), against their unevolved backbones. Self-evolution often raises capability: AgentEvolver lifts AppWorld goal completion from near zero to 20-36% across all conditions, and Autogenesis improves SkillsBench pass rate from 16.48% to 22.22%. But it rarely closes the language gap. Evolved systems remain stronger in English, by up to 0.26 DROP F1, the gap is largest on mul

translated_title: IRTIQA：以英语进化，以乌尔都语评估——智能体自我进化能否从英语迁移到乌尔都语及语码转换输入？
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型智能体日益从自身经验中学习，它们学习和评估所用的任务几乎总是英语的。我们探究自我进化能否从英语迁移到乌尔都语，并发布了IRTIQA——一个由DROP、SNIPS、AppWorld和SkillsBench的相互对齐的英语版、乌尔都语翻译版和乌尔都语语码转换版变体组成的基准，该基准采用矩阵语言语码转换流水线构建并经过人工验证。借助IRTIQA，我们评估了三个自我进化框架——Tool-R0（自我博弈强化学习）、AgentEvolver（经验引导强化学习）和Autogenesis（协议级进化），并与各自未进化的基座模型进行对比。自我进化通常能提升能力：AgentEvolver在所有条件下将AppWorld目标完成率从近乎零提升至20%-36%，Autogenesis将SkillsBench通过率从16.48%提升至22.22%。但它很少能弥合语言差距：进化后的系统在英语上依然更强，DROP F1最高领先0.26，且该差距在多（语码转换任务）上最大（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出IRTIQA基准（包含对齐的英语、乌尔都语及语码转换任务变体），发现智能体自我进化虽能显著提升任务能力，但收益主要局限于英语，很少能弥合与乌尔都语及语码转换输入之间的语言性能差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces IRTIQA, a benchmark of aligned English, Urdu, and code-switched task variants, and shows that while agent self-evolution improves capabilities overall, the gains rarely close the language gap, with evolved systems remaining stronger in English.
